newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle light at $103/dressed - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle light at $103/dressed - private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle near midday Wednesday sold at $103.00 per cwt on a dressed basis in light volume, steady with Tuesday, market sources said.

About 5,000 head sold near midday, with further bids at $103.00 passed by some feedlots pricing cattle at $104.00-$105.00, they said. There were no sales on a live basis, but cattle were priced at $64.00-$65.00.
Sales Tuesday started light, but blossomed after midday to 28,400 head at $103.00 and mostly $63.00 on a live basis, with a few at $64.00, sources said.

Wednesday's activity comes after Tuesday's sales which were reported at a top of $103.00 on a dressed basis and $64.00 to $65.00 on a live basis, the latter paid on a few loads of choice-type black cattle, USDA reported.
